# A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office / Source Authority

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A25′ — Covenant Architecture](conjugate/A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

A derivative office can exercise real authority without becoming the source of the field it serves. The relation begins before the office: someone has standing, something has been entrusted, obligations have been acknowledged, and an order has become available for interpretation and action. **Primary arbitration precedes its mediators.** The mediator receives an arbitrated field; receiving it does not make the mediator the source of arbitration.

An [apportioned criterion](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) can claim the ground of judgment which it received. Authority instead remains executable and answerable through [inherited entrustment](A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md). The office needs confidence enough to act, and the people relying upon it need a determinate place at which a decision can be made. Their trust grants standing to that place without transferring ownership of the relation.

## #1

Covenant gives this priority a binding form. It joins standing to obligation: the party who receives authority receives something to answer for. The source, the entrusted office and those affected by its decisions belong to one relation, while retaining different offices. [Primary arbitration](concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) grants standing; [derivative sovereignty](concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) exercises real authority from within what has been granted.

A contract can specify an exchange between parties whose standing it presupposes. Covenant, in this argument's use, reaches that presupposition: what relation gives the parties standing to promise, decide and bind themselves? Its obligations concern the continuance of that relation as well as the product exchanged. A [faithful definition](A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) has the corresponding obligation: its finite form accounts for a source while keeping the source able to answer beyond that form.

[Fides, Topos, Logos, Nomos, Natio and Credere](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md) differentiate enacted reliance, situated standing, articulated account, deciding order, inherited belonging and renewed entrustment. An office receives these conditions together while their work remains distinct. The comparison does not require one lexical root or one theology shared by the different covenant traditions.

## #2

Priest, king and politician receive standing and make it executable through different offices. Interpretation, memory, rite and transmission give a mediating office work to do. Judgment, distribution and protection give that work executable force. A king can person the unity of an order already received; a political office receives standing through constitution, electorate and institutional inheritance. Prior standing becomes situated execution through these differentiated offices. Their comparison supplies no universal historical succession.

Repeated execution can conceal the passage. People encounter the office whenever a decision is needed; the authority to decide then looks like the power which originally gave the field its standing. **Even the king receives an office.** A minister's claim to be king and a king's claim to originate the order therefore require the same distinction between received competence and appropriated source authority. Royal imagery alone does not settle which operation is being performed.

An interpretation becomes a [protected account](concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) when its identification with the source makes it immune to correction. Legitimate mediation retains its power to interpret and act. The failure begins when the people and relation from which that power comes can no longer address it except in terms it has already authorised.

## #3

[Apportionment](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md) makes the distribution of labour consequential for an office's authority. People carry out decisions, sustain infrastructure and encounter consequences the deciding position does not experience directly. If only the completed product returns, the office can appear self-sufficient while its dependence grows. [Delegated labour](concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) supplies its effective capacity; [the commissioning position](A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) must receive the cost, resistance and possibilities disclosed by that work.

Resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to reach the governing model, measure, instruction or purpose. An office which receives evidence only to grade the worker closes that route. A factual error may be corrected under a fitting instruction; a failed instruction or commission must reach an authority capable of revising it. Where the condition remains fitting, the office can retain it with reasons. The next act must inherit the warranted correction or retained terms.

Knowledge can give trust provisional anchors, or project the uncertainty it will not hold onto an excluded object. An [account held provisionally](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) gives reliance something determinate to stand upon while uncertainty remains; an account claiming total certainty displaces the distrust it cannot hold onto what it excludes. A returnable office supplies an anchor without requiring those who rely upon it to make it infallible. A [binding commitment](concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) remains finite without becoming disposable whenever difficulty appears; investigation, objection and renewed terms can belong to its fidelity.

## #4

In Bratton's [institutional scenario](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026), rules, roles, procedures, precedents and feedback make institutional performance possible. The intelligence embedded in that scaffold is not reducible to the intelligence of its occupants. Qualified persons, groups, agents or combinations can occupy a role while its function within the larger institution persists. Reliable outputs can become another institution's necessary inputs; nesting composes those dependencies while their received standing remains a further question. [Cultural interoperability](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q027) makes the arrangement situated: institutions accommodate plural norms and traditions, while new hybrid forms can reshape the cultures from which they emerge. Institutional performance and cultural transformation leave the legitimacy of each particular arrangement to be established.

Ostrom's [selected governance principles](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture.md#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q001) give return a different institutional form. Most affected individuals are authorised to participate in making and modifying rules; local users' rule-making rights receive recognition; interconnected resources can require nested governance. Her [warning against rigid transplantation](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture.md#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q002) makes the ecological and social conditions of an application consequential. These selected principles inform the proposed covenantal comparison; the lecture supplies neither a universal recipe nor validation of a QL commons.

In delegated software agency, goal, permission and evaluation criterion remain distinguishable from the intention they serve. The evaluator occupies a local judging centre: the result is known through the task, rules, evidence and context which mediate its judgment. Within the commissioning person's undertaking, that complete evaluating apparatus is itself a means; inspecting its self-model makes that content known in a further act without inventorying the person's first-person condition. [Authored ground](A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) makes the scope of delegation explicit. A contested result can correct the answer or task interpretation under an adequate criterion, while failure of the criterion, permission or purpose reaches the relevant commission. [Deferential intelligence](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) permits objection, alternative or refusal when fidelity requires it. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons; the later action must inherit the judgment. These obligations specify an architecture whose actual execution needs evidence.

## #5→0


A deciding office depends on forms, reports and allocations it did not originate, yet remains responsible for its exercise of jurisdiction. In Foucault's distributed account of power, an appeal can expose the commission through which that office acts. The effective reach of the appeal distinguishes a hearing from a route able to revise the rule or commission when either is implicated. Derivative standing retains real force within those dependencies; covenantal theological and historical relations have their own sources.


[Jewish, Christian and Islamic mediations](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT-language-law-nation-centralisation.md#branch-x-abrahamic) distribute source, interpreter, obligation and jurisdiction differently. Torah and halakhic continuity, Christian transregional and vernacular institutions, and Qur’anic Arabic within a multilingual umma give the offices particular relations. Their comparison asks how each mediation receives authority; it supplies no single Abrahamic constitutional chronology.

Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) distinguishes destruction, capture and counterfeit provenance. Destruction removes a city’s shared conditions; surveillance can retain its buildings while capturing the persons who inhabit them; a fabricated image can present itself as originating witness. An entrusted office remains answerable where affected people and conditions can challenge the commission it executes. The historical telling and Giegerich comparison retain their own source requirements.

An office exercises [Arbitration-in-Crisis](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis.md#arbitration-in-crisis) when it settles a consequential dispute. Primary standing, authorised interpretation and executed decision remain different offices. Returned labour and affected consequence can warrant correction of the decision, revision of its commission or retention of fitting terms. The mediator's necessary judgment keeps its competence while the authority through which it acts remains answerable.

In the [Mother, Assumption and chiasm](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-bearing-return), the receiving matrix bears a differentiated life and is itself received in the recognitional return. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Completion owes that bearing recognition without assigning one image ownership of the field. The embodied condition remains received within the life whose completion it bore; Mary's doctrinal appointments require their separate attribution.

[Entrustment keeps the return route active](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active) when an office makes authority executable and affected consequence can question its commission. Reliance needs a bearer able to answer beyond the account's present evidence. The achieved account gives that undertaking determinate terms; trust carries the undertaking into a further encounter where those terms can be tested, retained, corrected or withdrawn.

In [the Ares–Aphrodite relation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release), Poseidon answers for a possible loss and Hephaestus acts upon that undertaking. The bride-gifts claimed from Zeus, the spectators’ adulterer’s fine and Poseidon’s contingent payment retain different speakers and offices. Mediation has a particular bearer whose promise changes what can be done, without collapsing those claims into one historical legal instrument.

Authority returns with its consequence. An exercised source-relation has acquired a determinate act; those affected can answer to it; the office receives their answer at the condition it concerns. The result can warrant a corrected decision, renewed scope, revised commission or reasoned retention. Covenant renews through the judgment inherited by the next use of power. Fidelity lets exercised authority encounter the conditions it was entrusted to serve.

[Distinct worlds can accommodate one another](A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) without making one account sovereign over the others. [Compassionate attention](A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) returns an institutional achievement toward its sustaining persons, histories and labour. The affiliated [4:2 Technē proposal](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/42-techne/42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons/42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons.md) gives collective organisation a design direction. Applying it requires its own executable arrangements and evaluation; receiving a completed design is still different from inheriting its consequences in practice.

[Answerable arbitration](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) retains the positive criterion: authority is derivative, real and consequential through the labour and lives upon which its exercise depends. The office can decide because it receives standing; that standing remains addressable because the office does not exhaust what grants it.

In [Job's ending](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return), the friends whose account has been rebuked must receive Job's prayer. His intercession has real consequence without making him the source of its authority. A bearer they misjudged changes their relation through that mediation. Serving an originating relation and appropriating its authority remain different acts; this narrative supplies no general constitutional history of covenant.

In [the Prisoner's administered world](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world), successive occupants of Number Two inherit authority while withholding its source from the governed. The question of why Six resigned and the machinery of confinement persist through their replacement. Even Six's election leaves the governing relation intact. Holding an office therefore needs answerability for its terms: changing the occupant does not make delegated power self-authorising or let the captive's command govern.


### Source and institutional standing

Covenantal, legal and theological histories retain their own witnesses. The selected Peters passages remain a distinct historical source task. Taylor's destruction/capture/counterfeit image and Mother office comparison do not by themselves verify a political allegation, an intellectual genealogy or a doctrinal title. The religious, narrative and institutional appointments above remain source-specific.

The Agentworld propositions retain the brief's scenario modality. Ostrom's selected principles concern situated governance; the affiliated 4:2 Technē proposal has separate implementation, evaluation and public bibliographic requirements. A local judging office and its mediating apparatus can be inspected within a containing inquiry; its description supplies neither an executed result nor ownership of the immediate condition of knowing. A general return requires the warranted correction or justified retention to reach the next act. A stronger claim that processing changed requires the identified changed condition and its later inheritance to be shown.
